about_the_game:
Before the troops move, go ahead with food and supplies! Powerful consumables supply, essential for novice battles!

This DLC is exclusively for beginners who purchase the game within 15 days. For old players who purchase the gift package after 15 days, it is not valid and cannot be refunded!

This DLC contains the following content:

Xingshi Pill -100 pieces, 200 points of force

Cod Pills -100 pieces, Intelligence 200 points

Brown Bear Maru -100 pieces, command 200 points

Leopard Pill -100 pieces, agile 200 points

Sea Dog Maru -100 Lucky 200 Points

Experience Fruit -50 pieces increase by 50 levels

50% gold -10 yuan, 60000 yuan

Roasted chicken legs -20 pieces can restore 999 health points after use

After using 20 bottles of Dongma wine, 999 mana can be restored

Eating 10 rice cakes can permanently increase attack power by 5 points

Eating 10 walnuts can permanently increase 5 points of mental energy

Novice exclusive benefits, super high cost-effectiveness, don't miss out!

Note: If you have purchased but have not received this DLC, please enter the "Start Game" interface of Steam Hanwu Emperor Legend. There is a "Manage My DLC" button at the bottom right corner of the interface. Remove all other hooks that only keep this DLC and content add-on DLC to enter the game "Yuanbao Mall" and click "Purchase and Receive". After receiving it, check other DLCs. Only one operation is needed, and once successful, all archives will be permanently valid.
